headwords: tôi suy nghĩ, vậy nên tôi tồn tại
tôi tư duy, nên tôi tồn tại

flags.why: Tôn hiệu is a conferred honorific title, rather than a regnal name ([source](https://vnexpress.net/phan-biet-ten-vua-viet-nam-nhu-the-nao-3797852.html)).
The example defines the term instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Tổ chức này kêu gọi trả tự do cho các tù nhân lương tâm. = This organization calls for the release of prisoners of conscience.

flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label ([source](https://nghengu.vn/chuyen-nguoi-nghe-ke/tu-dien-tieng-mien-nam-2032.html)).
Tú lơ khơ remains an everyday Northern term for playing cards, so dated misleadingly suggests it has fallen out of use.
